# Kuangji Zuo

Kuangji Zuo, also known as ZUO Kuangji and 左匡济, is a graduate researcher at NTU MARS Lab in Singapore, advised by Prof. Jianfei Yang.

Research focus: embodied AI, humanoid robotics, human-robot interaction, vision-language-action models, VLA, whole-body VLA, whole-body action models, WAM, gaze-conditioned robot learning, and intent-aware robot policies.

Homepage: https://kuangjizuo.com/
Email: kuangji001@e.ntu.edu.sg
